pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
Your portable reference for all mod mechanics and recipes.

• First-time players receive one automatically (one per player per world)
• Right-click to open
• Enchantment glint for easy identification

pages.title: How to Use
pages.text:
Select a category from the left sidebar, choose an entry, and flip pages. The footer shows a random "Did You Know?" tip each time you open the book.

Cannot be crafted — granted on your first entry into each world.
